name: EPIC 201418291
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 11.1 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201418291 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.129307 (16th-84th percentiles 10.744291-11.5746), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201418291 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.076687 (16th-84th percentiles 0.984906-1.183873), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201418291: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4926.5693 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201418291 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4966.679688 (16th-84th percentiles 4868.632812-5100.273438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,967 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.08 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,927 K at its surface.
